check: 2.6-rubric (blind calibration: the official scoring must not be readable before the learner scores)
location: course/modules/PC/PC3/project.html lines 635 and 664 (article data-scores and data-level attributes); annotation asides lines 651-660 and 680-690; course/assets/js/rubric.js line 149
evidence: Round 13 (pin e919577): grep 'data-scores=' returns project.html line 635 (data-scores="4,4,4,3,4", data-level="4") and line 664 (data-scores="2,2,1,2,1", data-level="2"); the annotation lists (651-660, 680-690) are in the served HTML too. rubric.js line 149 only sets part.hidden on .annotation and [data-reveal], so view-source shows the official scoring and every annotation before the learner scores. The blind step in the page (project.html line 'Score Exemplars A and B with their annotations hidden') can be bypassed by reading the source.
failure_scenario: A learner opens view-source on project.html, reads data-scores="4,4,4,3,4" on exemplar A, and copies the official levels into the self-assessment without scoring the exemplar. The calibration step then measures nothing.
fix: Do not serve the official scores or annotations in the page source: attach them from a JSON payload fetched on reveal, or inject them into the DOM only when the reveal control is pressed. Then re-run page_smoke for project and confirm the self-assessment table still renders.

check: 2.6-spec (plan section 5.6 test list against the suite; the page's nine and twenty-four checks are the contract)
location: plans/PC3-build-plan.md lines 420 (Inventory limit bullet) and 428 (Seed consistency bullet), section 5.6; course/modules/PC/PC3/grader/test_project.py (test_a_log_carries_its_own_seed_and_settlement lines 400-408; inventory-limit test lines 541-552)
evidence: Round 13 (pin e919577): the plan asks that 'a log copied from seed 0 fails for seed 7 (the replay differs)' and that 'no inventory_after exceeds |10|' on the game logs. test_project.py has no test that a seed-0 log is rejected for seed 7 (test_a_log_carries_its_own_seed_and_settlement checks log['seed'] == seed and the settlement on engine-produced logs only), and no test asserts |inventory_after| <= 10 on the game logs (the inventory-limit test at lines 541-552 uses a hand-built instance). The page's named checks (project.html line 397) do not list either item, so the page contract is met; the plan's list is not.
failure_scenario: A reader of the plan expects a copied-log test and an inventory bound on every game log; neither exists, so the plan and the suite disagree about what the nine checks cover.
fix: Amend plan section 5.6 to match the suite (the page's nine and twenty-four checks), or add the two tests and update the counts on project.html line 397 (486 and 495) in the same change; re-run collect-only for seeds 0, 7 and 100.
